name_de: Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE44 HPC SLX Evo 800 artline
name_en: Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE44 HPC SLX Evo 800 artline
description_de: Das Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE44 HPC SLX Evo 800 artline ist ein vollgefedertes E-Mountainbike von Cube. Der Antrieb (Bosch Performance Line CX) mit bis zu 120 Nm Drehmoment wird von einem 800-Wh-Akku gespeist, bedient wird er über Bosch Kiox 400C. Federung: Fox 36 Float Performance GRIP, Tapered, 15x110mm, E-Bike Optimized, 150mm (S: 140mm) · Dämpfer Fox Float Performance, 230x60mm (27.5: 210x55mm)…. Schaltung: Shimano XT Di2 RD-M8260-SGS, 12-Speed, Electronic Shifting System. Bremsen: Shimano XT BR-M8220, Hydr. Disc Brake w/ Front ABS (203/203). Rahmen: Carbon Front Triangle. Erhältlich in den Größen S, M, L, XL.
description_en: The Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE44 HPC SLX Evo 800 artline is a full-suspension electric mountain bike from Cube. The drive (Bosch Performance Line CX) with up to 120 Nm of torque is powered by an 800 Wh battery, controlled via Bosch Kiox 400C. Suspension: Fox 36 Float Performance GRIP, Tapered, 15x110mm, E-Bike Optimized, 150mm (S: 140mm) · Dämpfer Fox Float Performance, 230x60mm (27.5: 210x55mm)…. Drivetrain: Shimano XT Di2 RD-M8260-SGS, 12-Speed, Electronic Shifting System. Brakes: Shimano XT BR-M8220, Hydr. Disc Brake w/ Front ABS (203/203). Frame: Carbon Front Triangle. Available in sizes S, M, L, XL.
